skillTree.localised_description: "They said soon. They always say soon. We hunger still. Send News!"
"It's a rabbit's foot. A rabbit. No… Oh never mind - it brings me luck. It does! Trust me!"
You'd better kill this one or they'll keep coming back until one of you is dead. Even then, there's no guarantee it'll be over!

Chef Bottom Eater plates up a steaming heap of twice cooked scraps straight from the galley of the Flaccid Fury, featuring a flavor profile so violently foul, or shockingly sublime, that it literally wakes the dead!

Gathering beneath the Galley's overflowing pot, the voracious crabs are coated by the heavy dripping runoff, baking right against the hot base of the vessel into a stiff, calcified shell that leaves them completely impenetrable!

skillTree.localised_description: A foul, highly contagious parting gift passed freely from the crew's scuttling companions, ensuring that any enemy who gets too close takes home a persistent reminder that keeps on burning.

skillTree.localised_description: Chef Bottom Eater dispenses a strictly private, and heavily guarded personal drizzle reserved exclusively for himself, a legendary secret sampled by no more than seven fortunate souls, who all swear it leaves a surprising, distinct hint of pineapple on the tongue...
"Yes, they’re from the east. Annoying, yet useful - their hides, particularly…"
An all-but-unstoppable terror, when the Mournguls descend they rend and devour yet never know satisfaction.
Strike true; strike hard.
The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
The Mourngul's insatiable appetite gives a further boost to its ravening slaughter.
For every wound the Mourngul inflicts in combat, it can regenerate its own injuries.
Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.
"Don't look into their eyes, there is only death there!"
The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.
Those in the army can find succour or be replenished by the power of this champion.

attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.
This unit can cause terror, making its melee target rout for a short time. Units that cause terror are immune to terror and fear themselves.
This unit can hide in forests until enemy units get too close.
Speed and combat penalties caused by terrain are ignored by this unit.

Undead units cannot be routed, but take damage when their Leadership is broken.
	
	Undead units also have:
	 Fear and Terror Immunity
	
	Undead units may also have their hit points restored by special characters such as the Vampire Counts Necromancer.
